g.text: For Evaluation only; not FCC approved for resale
For Evaluation only; not FCC approved for resale
1. All MSL components should be baked as per JEDEC
2. PCB should be baked at 120 degree for 8 hours.
3. Board assembly must comply with workmanship
4. These assemblies are ESD sensitive, ESD
5. These assemblies must be clean and free from flux
all contaminants. Use of no clean flux is not
